newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Wit GM disposal boosts net asset value.
newsitem.headline: Wit GM disposal boosts net asset value.

text.p: Witwatersrand Gold Mining Company Ltd said on Wednesday that its net asset value would increase 502 percent as a result of a net surplus arising on the revaluation of disposed properties.
It said that with effect from March 17 it had disposed of its property division to an ad hoc Realisation Trust, of which it is the sole beneficiary, for 51.05 million rand.
The amount was being carried on loan account and would be settled by the Realisation Trust out of the cash generated from the realisation of the properties.
The disposal was part of an overall restructuring or unbundling process, which would enable Wit GM to refocus on its core mining related assets.
Attributable revenue from the disposal was 1.186 million.

While earnings per share would not be affected by the disposal, it said its net asset value, calculated on some 9.53 million shares in issue at June 30 1996, would increase to 560 cents from 93 cents.
